method: Each prompt ran in a new ephemeral MCP-only session. Tool names were not supplied as expected answers, and built-in web, browser, and terminal use was prohibited.

before_metadata_revision.prompt: Understand https://example.com: what is on it, what state is it in, and what can be done?

metadata_change: verify_web now says not to call it merely before or alongside understand_webpage; MCP server instructions reserve it for explicit deployment, reachability, HTTP, TLS, redirect, or exact-text requests.
known_host_behavior: When built-in web search and shell are available, this Codex host may still prefer them over third-party MCP. MCP-only routing now selects the two 404.directory tools correctly and avoids pairing them unnecessarily.
